source.evidence: (R) PB2 group play: the reach of shared kill, collect and objective credit in the open world, about the distance two players fighting one camp stand apart. Inside a battle or dungeon instance the whole instance counts.

The captured ClientPcProfile records in startup/self_data.json (reader 00911d60): the icon is the record's fifth dword and the badge image set its seventh. The group window reads them from member record +0x9c and +0xa0 (00a7cd60 columns 4 and 3).
